shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md; cat .lore/dod.md; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; sed -n '1,250p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '1,210p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat .lore/dod.md; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; rg -n \"spec:|specs/.*#\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -20; sed -n '1,90p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; cat package.json | sed -n '1,45p';"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"@spec|spec-anchor|specAnchor\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' . | head -40; test -e scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo yes || echo no"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts | head -18; sed -n '23,30p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git status --short; git diff --check"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(orchestrator): pin beforeSession failure hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
